questions.prompt: In Aristotle's Poetics, how does anagnorisis differ from peripeteia?

choices.text: It is a change of setting rather than a change of speaker
It is a comic resolution rather than a tragic one
It is a change from ignorance to knowledge rather than a reversal of events
It is an opening invocation rather than a closing speech

questions.hint: These two changes can occur together at a decisive moment in a tragedy.
questions.explanation: Anagnorisis is recognition or discovery. Peripeteia is a reversal in the action; the two can occur together.
